question: Rudrankksh Patil is associated with ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**shooting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rudrankksh Patil is an emerging talent in the sport of shooting, representing India at various national and international competitions.
 
• He has shown remarkable proficiency in the 10m air rifle category, a discipline where competitors aim at a target from a distance of 10 meters using an air rifle.
 
• Rudrankksh has garnered attention for his precision and consistency in shooting, traits vital for excelling in this sport.
 
• He has been training rigorously under the guidance of experienced coaches and is considered one of the promising young shooters in the Indian shooting circuit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **10m Air Rifle Shooting**

 
 
• This is a precision shooting event where athletes shoot a series of shots using a 4.5 mm caliber air rifle at a target 10 meters away.
 
• The event is governed by the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) and is included in the Olympics, World Championships, and various other international competitions.
 
• The target used in this event has a total of 10 concentric scoring rings, with the innermost ring worth 10 points and each outer ring worth one point less.
 
• Competitors typically shoot from a standing position, and the event requires immense control, focus, and steadiness to score high.
 
 
 
• **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF)**
 
 
• The ISSF is the governing body for Olympic shooting events in rifle, pistol, and shotgun disciplines.
 
• It was founded in 1907 and is responsible for setting the rules and regulations for international shooting competitions.
 
• The ISSF organizes the World Championships, World Cups, and oversees shooting events at the Olympic Games.
 
• It aims to promote the sport of shooting and ensure fair play and sportsmanship in all its competitions.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Shooting Events**
 
 
• Shooting has been part of the Olympic Games since the first modern Games in 1896.
 
• There are various shooting events in the Olympics, including rifle, pistol, and shotgun disciplines, for both men and women.
 
• The events are designed to test the accuracy and precision of the athletes under highly regulated conditions.
 
• Olympic shooting events are highly competitive, with athletes from all over the world competing for the prestigious Olympic medals.
